tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Verification Policy

TLS certificate verification stays enabled on all builds, development builds included; there is no development-only exemption. This project also records a rule of HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It says TLS certificate verification stays on for all builds, development builds included, with no development-only exemption. It also notes the separate recorded rule of HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exceptions.

The first attempt to create the file with a shell command errored, so I wrote it with the file tool instead. I didn't read the file back to check it.

The statement comes from two recorded decisions. #27 withdrew the earlier note that development builds could skip verification, and #30 is the HTTPS-everywhere rule. I left out the retired exemption, as you asked.
